note: Naive's versions, the migrations that move a venture from one to the next, and each package's version and channel (EE-076, the Next.js translation's chapter 18). naive upgrade reads this file from the installed copy, so a venture always upgrades to the framework it runs on. A version's guide is bundled here, in docs/upgrades/, so agents read the guide for the version installed (I-29).

channels.stable: Packages Naive models and computes fit for. The default.
channels.canary: Stable packages plus experimental ones: packages Naive does not model yet (fit is not computed), adopted only when a person asks for one by name.

versions.summary: The layer layout: records under purpose/, knowledge/, operations/, governance/ and pillars/ (EE-030, EE-032). A venture with no pin in naive.config.json is on this version.
The package folder layout: records move into foundation/, validation/, product/, marketing/, people/ and decisions/, with the old routes kept as aliases (EE-070).
Packages are Naive's and kits are Mentura's (EE-071): naive.config.json pins the framework and each package, and routes inside records are package routes.

migrations.decision: Torian, 2026-10-29: one record per ideal customer profile
Torian, 2026-10-30: an opinionated schema with swappable frameworks for thinking; the telos and ambition tiers become frameworks over canonical goals and exit criteria
